question: A piece of work can be completed by P and Q together in 24 days, and the same piece of work can be completed by R alone in 60 days. If P and R together can do the same work in 36 days, then find the time taken by Q to complete this piece of work alone.
solution:
Given:

A piece of work can be completed by P and Q together in 24 days, and the same piece of work can be completed by R alone in 60 days. 

P and R together can do the same work in 36 days.

Concept used:

If A and B alone can complete a task in X and Y days respectively, then they together will take = XY/(X + Y) days to complete the work.
